'''90,000 BBY''', or '''90,000<ref name="Atlas" /> Before the Battle of Yavin''', was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> that fell within the [[Pre-Republic era]].<ref name="Era" /> It was said that the [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] stood as a many tiered [[City/Legends|settlement]] as early as 90,000 BBY. [[Millennium/Legends|Thousands of years]] later,<ref name="Atlas" /> by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Triv">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep519|text="To Catch a Jedi" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|planet-spanning]]<ref name="Atlas" /> settlement had grown to 5,127 levels<ref name="Triv" /> stretching [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the surface.<ref name="Dark Apprentice">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The [[1994]] novel ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'' by [[Dave Wolverton]] was the first source to establish that several of the levels of the Galactic City were more than ninety thousand years old by the time of the novel's events,<ref name="Courtship">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> which are set in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], subsequently explicitly introduced the year 90,000 BBY in the context of the history of Coruscant's planet-wide city.<ref name="Atlas" />
